heroes.name: Crow
heroes.description: Control hero who applies Silence and punishes enemies by extending Silence windows and dealing extra damage. Very dangerous to Mages and high-Intelligence enemies.
heroes.best_synergy: Polaris, Phobos, Byrna, Aidan, Isaac, Judge, Julius, Iris, Tempus, Electra, Miu, Folio, Amira, Satori, Kayla

skills.name: Silent Judgment
skills.targeting: Attacks enemies in the front and applies Silence to all enemies whose main stat is Intelligence.
skills.description: Crow attacks enemies in the front, applying Silence for 8.0 seconds to all Intelligence-main-stat enemies.

skills.name: Silent Judgment
skills.description: Silent Judgment now applies Silence to all enemies for 8.0 seconds.

skills.name: Holy Grenade
skills.description: Throws a grenade at the enemy with the highest Intelligence, applying Silence for 5.0 seconds. The target and nearby enemies take physical area damage.

skills.name: Holy Grenade
skills.description: Grenade shards deal physical damage to all Silenced enemies and enemies around them. Silence duration is increased by 2.0 seconds for all affected targets.

skills.name: Swift Retribution
skills.description: For 12.0 seconds, Crow's skills recharge 30% faster, and his basic attacks deal an additional hit to all enemies affected by Silence.

skills.name: Final Verdict
skills.trigger: When Crow applies Silence to an enemy that already has Silence active.
skills.description: When Crow reapplies Silence to an enemy that already has the same active effect, the enemy takes physical damage. The effect's duration is increased by the duration of the longest Silence already affecting the enemy.

skills.name: Witch Hunt
skills.description: Every 12.0 seconds, Crow attacks the enemy with the highest Intelligence. If the target is Silenced, Crow spreads the effect to all nearby enemies for the remaining duration. Otherwise, he applies Silence for 5.0 seconds.

skills.name: Confinement
skills.active_condition: At least one enemy is Silenced.
skills.description: While at least one enemy is Silenced, enemies cannot apply Debuffs or Curses. The skill remains active while Crow is alive.

artifacts.name: Holy Grenade
artifacts.effect: Team-wide Physical Attack bonus for 9 seconds when Crow uses Silent Judgment.

synergies.reason: Fafnir prioritizes Agility-main-stat allies for Runic Shield and boosts physical attack damage with Runic Blade, making Crow stronger and harder to kill.

relevant_skills.name: Runic Shield
relevant_skills.note: Heroes with Agility as their main stat are prioritized when selecting a target.

relevant_skills.name: Runic Blade
relevant_skills.honor_bonus_note: While allied Honor Heroes attack enemies with the Strength main stat, their bonus from this skill is doubled.

synergies.reason: Thea can apply Silence with Vow of Silence, helping Crow keep Silence active for Swift Retribution, Final Verdict, Witch Hunt, and Confinement. In the current meta this is more of an optional/off-meta synergy because Crow already applies enough Silence pressure by himself.

relevant_skills.name: Vow of Silence
relevant_skills.note: Chance to apply Silence decreases if the target's level is higher than 120.

synergies.reason: Keira's Blade Whirlwind can Silence enemies, creating more targets for Crow's Silence-based punishment. Like Thea, she can improve Silence uptime, but she is not required for Crow to perform well and is currently outside the strongest meta options.

relevant_skills.name: Blade Whirlwind
relevant_skills.note: Silence debuff can affect higher-level enemies.

best_teams.label: Team 1
best_teams.testing_note: Strong anti-mage control composition. Crow's repeated Silence weakens high-Intelligence threats while Phobos, Iris, Tempus, and Electra add pressure and control.

best_teams.label: Team 2
best_teams.testing_note: Progress-style control team where Crow adds heavy Silence pressure against mages while Isaac, Judge, Julius, and Polaris keep the team stable and disruptive.

best_teams.label: Team 3
best_teams.testing_note: Sustain and pressure composition. Aidan, Byrna, and Kayla create a durable core while Polaris and Crow keep enemies controlled.

best_teams.label: Team 4
best_teams.testing_note: Magic-heavy control team. Crow helps suppress enemy mages while Miu, Phobos, Folio, and Iris provide strong magical pressure.

best_teams.label: Team 5
best_teams.testing_note: Mystery/control composition. Crow adds Silence lockdown while Amira, Satori, Phobos, and Byrna support a slower but highly disruptive fight.

notes: Crow is especially dangerous to Mages because multiple skills target enemies with the highest Intelligence or punish Intelligence-main-stat enemies.
Silence is the core of Crow's kit. Reapplying Silence activates Final Verdict, while active Silence enables Swift Retribution, Witch Hunt spreading, and Confinement.

In battle testing, Crow performed very strongly because he applies Silence repeatedly, especially against mages and enemies with the highest Intelligence. This can leave enemy teams locked down for long windows.
Crow does not need off-meta Silence helpers such as Thea or Keira to work well. They can add more Silence, but Crow's own kit already creates enough Silence pressure in strong meta teams.

Crow is especially effective into strong mage threats such as Iris, Folio, and Miu. Even damage-over-time teams can struggle because Confinement prevents enemies from applying Debuffs and Curses while at least one enemy is Silenced.
The Talisman of Retribution adds Agility +2000, which gives Crow Physical Attack +6000 and Armor +2000 because Agility is his main stat.
